questions.q: Change the following sentence into superlative degree.
o: No other mountain is highest than Mount Everest.
Mount Everest is high mountain in the world.
Mount Everest is the highest mountain in the world.
Mount Everest is higher than any other mountain in the world.
questions.s:
Correct answer:Mount Everest is the highest mountain in the world.

Explanation:

The original sentence is in the positive degree:
"No other mountain in the world is as high as Mount Everest."

To change it to the superlative degree, we use the structure:
Subject + is the + superlative adjective + noun + (in/of the group)

Let’s evaluate the options:

  • No other mountain is highest than Mount Everest. – ❌ incorrect structure; "highest" should be used with "the," and "than" doesn’t go with superlative

  • Mount Everest is high mountain in the world. – ❌ missing article "the" and incorrect adjective form

  • Mount Everest is the highest mountain in the world. – ✅ correct superlative degree construction

  • Mount Everest is higher than any other mountain in the world. – ✔️ correct but this is comparative, not superlative

So, the correct superlative form is: Mount Everest is the highest mountain in the world.
